maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from franchise royalties and food sales at Wendy's burger restaurants, which are consumables, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers buying burgers, breakfast and drinks, and franchisees pay royalties; government isn't the payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by franchising and opening new Wendy's restaurants and menu launches, not through regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other fast-food chains; franchisees are bound by agreements, but diners face no switching cost.

notes: Franchisees face contractual lock-in, but the end customer is the consumer, so I judged on consumer switching.
